system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Submits a formal insurance claim for a reported crop loss event. For your information, my claim_id is None, my policy_id is None.

function.name: pmfby_submit_claim
function.description: Submits a formal insurance claim for a reported crop loss event. Transitions claim_status from 'reported' to 'submitted'. Requires session_token. Loss must have been reported first using pmfby_report_crop_loss. This tool does NOT approve claims or process compensation. Fails if: no loss event is reported, policy is not active, claim_status is not 'reported', or a duplicate claim exists for the same loss.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

policy_id.description: Unique identifier of the insurance policy.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier of the crop loss claim generated during reporting.

estimated_loss_percentage.description: Farmer's estimated percentage of crop loss (0-100).
